description: Continued fraction of a square root. sqrt(2) is [1; 2, 2, 2, ...] and the period is 1. sqrt(3) has period 2. A perfect square is one term and period 0. The period is the repeating length, even when fewer terms are requested. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cf-sqrt
